relationship_notes: Japanese handmade fuzz builder identified by TC Gakki as Kuroki, described as a builder who loves beer and fuzz. Current surviving catalog evidence centers on multiple Fuzz Face-inspired fuzz models. DDH Booster is retained as relationship-only because its primary role is booster rather than central dirt. Extremely small production quantities are documented in dealer records, making exterior/specimen preservation particularly valuable.
